name: Montiel (Spain)
description: Divided per saltire, white above and below and crimson at the hoist and fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Montiel (a cross of Saint James and a castle on white) above two crossed swords.
history: The flag of Montiel shows four triangles formed by the intersection of its two diagonals; it was approved together with the anthem on 1 April 2015.
